import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import kit, encode
types = [
  {"name":"Bool","kind":"bool"},
  {"name":"Nib","kind":"int","bits":4},
  {"name":"Word","kind":"int","bits":16},
  {"name":"Str","kind":"string","maxsize":5},
  {"name":"Arr","kind":"array","element":"Nib","size":3},
  {"name":"St","kind":"struct","fields":[["x","Nib"],["y","Nib"]]},
]
def mod(name, requires, params=None):
    return {"name":name,"params":params or [["n","Nib"],["arr","Arr"],["st","St"],["s","Str"],["x","Nib"]],
            "result":["r","Bool"],"requires":requires}
P={"n":15,"arr":[1,2,3],"st":{"x":1,"y":2},"s":[97,0,98,99,100],"x":9}
cases = {
 # (requires, expected READY?)
 "all-true":      (["all","e",["var","arr"],["lt",["var","e"],["const","Nib",4]]], True),
 "all-false":     (["all","e",["var","arr"],["lt",["var","e"],["const","Nib",3]]], False),
 "all-empty-true":(["all","e",["const","Arr",[0,0,0]],["gt",["var","e"],["const","Nib",100]]], False),
 "shadow":        (["and",["all","x",["var","arr"],["lt",["var","x"],["const","Nib",4]]],
                          ["eq",["var","x"],["const","Nib",9]]], True),
 "shadow-leak":   (["and",["all","x",["var","arr"],["lt",["var","x"],["const","Nib",4]]],
                          ["eq",["var","x"],["const","Nib",3]]], False),
 "nested-shadow": (["all","x",["var","arr"],["all","x",["var","arr"],["eq",["var","x"],["var","x"]]]], True),
 "add-mod":       (["eq",["add",["var","n"],["const","Nib",1]],["const","Nib",0]], True),
 "sub-mod":       (["eq",["sub",["var","n"],["const","Nib",3]],["const","Nib",12]], True),
 "add-16bit":     (["eq",["add",["const","Word",65535],["const","Word",2]],["const","Word",1]], True),
 "match":         (["match",["var","s"],"a*"], True),      # recovered "a"
 "match-full":    (["match",["var","s"],"[a-z]"], True),
 "match-nul":     (["match",["const","Str","a\u0000bcd"],"a*"], False),
 "match-const-nul": (["match",["const","Str","a\u0000bcd"],"a\u0000bcd"], True),
 "match-empty":   (["match",["const","Str",""],[""], True) if False else (["match",["const","Str",""],""], True),
 "match-star-empty": (["match",["const","Str",""],["a-z]*"], True),
 "match-class":   (["match",["var","s"],"[a-c]|[x-z]"], True),
 "match-no":      (["match",["var","s"],"b*"], False),
 "index":         (["eq",["index",["var","arr"],2],["const","Nib",3]], True),
 "field":         (["lt",["field",["var","st"],"x"],["field",["var","st"],"y"]], True),
 "eq-deep":       (["eq",["var","st"],["const","St",{"x":1,"y":2}]], True),
 "eq-deep-no":    (["eq",["var","st"],["const","St",{"x":1,"y":3}]], False),
 "eq-arr":        (["eq",["var","arr"],["const","Arr",[1,2,3]]], True),
 "not":           (["not",["eq",["var","n"],["const","Nib",1]]], True),
 "implies":       (["implies",["eq",["var","n"],["const","Nib",1]],["eq",["var","n"],["const","Nib",2]]], True),
 "implies-f":     (["implies",["eq",["var","n"],["const","Nib",15]],["eq",["var","n"],["const","Nib",2]]], False),
 "or":            (["or",["eq",["var","n"],["const","Nib",1]],["eq",["var","n"],["const","Nib",15]]], True),

}
mods=[]; runs=[]
for i,(k,(req,exp)) in enumerate(cases.items()):

          "entries":[m["name"] for m in mods],"machine":None,"runs":[]}
plan=kit.run(campaign)["plans"][0]
m=mods[0]
def mk(r):
    objs,n=encode.build(types,m,P,r); assert n==plan["variables"]; return kit.encode(objs)

for (name,k,exp),rec in zip(runs,out["records"]):
    got = rec["status"]=="READY"
    ok = (got==exp)

    print("%-4s %-18s expected=%-5s got=%s" % ("OK" if ok else "BAD", k, exp, rec["status"]))
